summary: Victim was targeted through WhatsApp and Telegram by individuals posing as trading agents using stolen Instagram photos and directing funds to repeatedly rebranded LibertyTradePips domains which blocked withdrawals consistent with a pig butchering scheme.
user_mistake: Sent funds to an online trading site introduced through unsolicited messaging and impersonation
prevention: Refuse investment offers initiated through messaging apps / Verify domain history and regulatory registration before sending funds
